title: An Audio-Ultrasound Synchronized Database of Tongue Movement for Mandarin speech
task: sustained vowels; monosyllables; sentence reading; dysarthric patient vowel/monosyllable/word tasks
token_or_recording_size: 22.31 hours synchronized audio+ultrasound; ~676.16 GB; 43 healthy + 11 dysarthric speakers
annotation_target: audio; sagittal tongue ultrasound; .lab transcripts; phone/syllable TextGrids; task/item metadata; patient pronunciation labels
manual_scope: Healthy-speech MFA/VAD alignment was manually inspected to ensure reliability; all patient annotations were performed manually. Ultrasound acquisition/anomaly quality was additionally human monitored/reviewed.
decision_reason: Primary synchronized production corpus with explicitly human-verified healthy alignment and fully manual patient annotation; too large to mirror, so ingest metadata/manifests and derived structured layers by reference pending dataset-license verification.
evidence_summary: Scientific Data reports 43 healthy and 11 dysarthric Mandarin speakers and 22.31 h of synchronized audio/UTI. Data annotation used MFA/VAD followed by manual inspection; patient annotations were entirely manual. Archive is ~676.16 GB on ScienceDB.
